LanguageData.SyrDoorMatsSlowdownTooltip: Simulates a person (or animal) cleaning their feet by slowing them on doormats, does not affect pathfinding
LanguageData.SyrDoorMatsSlowdownIfDirtyTip: Slowdown will only be applied when a person (or animal) is carrying filth
LanguageData.SyrDoorMatsAnimalsAllowTip: Note: this may have significant performance impacts
LanguageData.SyrDoorMatsAnimalsIntelligenceToolTip: Allows animals with this trainability level or greater to use doormats.
